text: では　はじめに　きみの　ことを　おしえて　もらおう！

structure.jp: おしえて　もらおう！
structure.en: let me have you tell me!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえて　もらおう
patterns.explanation: てもらう means you get someone to do something for you. おしえて　もらおう = 'I'll have you tell me'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending is the casual 'let's' or 'I think I will'. もらおう = 'let me get'.
